captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a prosumer-style handheld camcorder. It features a dark, blocky main camera body with a top carrying handle, a long multi-segmented cylindrical front lens barrel with a ridged control ring, and a rectangular flip-out side monitor behind a side handgrip. The monitor panel is mounted on a vertical hinge allowing it to swing open, the lens ring is designed to rotate continuously around the barrel axis, and three small rectangular buttons are embedded on the side below the screen opening for independent push action.
captions.instruction: Generate a prosumer-scale handheld camcorder model with a dark, blocky main body, a top handle, a long cylindrical front lens barrel with a rotatable ring, and an articulated flip-out side screen. Ensure the side screen pivots on a vertical hinge, the lens ring rotates continuously, and three small side buttons depress independently.
captions.factory: The code constructs the camcorder by defining a main base body using a Box primitive, with a top handle and side grip added as additional Box visual shapes. The lens assembly utilizes nested Cylinder primitives, including a main barrel, a flared front lens, and a separate ridged cylinder for the focus ring. A side monitor is created as a thin Box, attached via a revolute joint on a vertical axis. Finally, three small prismatic buttons are modeled as separate Box shapes, each configured with a prismatic joint to allow independent depression into the side wall.
